newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB'S DAVIGNON: NO RETIREMENT PLANS, THANK YOU.
newsitem.headline: SGB'S DAVIGNON: NO RETIREMENT PLANS, THANK YOU.

text.p: Etienne Davignon, chairman of the board of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) , said he had no retirement plans.
"It is highly unlikely that you would see a big change in SGB management in 1997, I still plan to be around," Davignon told Reuters in an interview on Thursday.

Davignon, who turns 65 in October, said he was looking forward to reading books, cooking and spending more time with his grandchildren if and when he retires, but that it was too early to think about that now.
SGB chief executive officer Philippe Liotier -- a Frenchman who represents SGB parent company Compagnie de Suez -- also turns 65 this year.

Belgian media have speculated that when the two retire, the new management team will consist of a French chairman of the board and a Belgian CEO, a structure which would better reflect the balance of power within the group.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
